description: Publish an HTML or Markdown document as a hosted page on htmldrop. Returns the public share URL. Use this whenever a user asks to publish, share, or 'put on the web' some HTML / Markdown content. Pass exactly one of `html` or `markdown`.

html.description: Raw HTML document content. Either this or `markdown` must be set.

markdown.description: Markdown content. Will be rendered to HTML on the server. Either this or `html` must be set.

slug.description: Optional URL slug (3-63 chars, lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens). If omitted, a random slug is assigned.

title.description: Optional title shown in the dashboard list.

name: htmldrop_publish

id.description: Opaque site id. Pass to htmldrop_delete to remove later.

slug.description: Resolved slug for the published site.

url.description: Public share URL of the published page.
